description: Mutation golden fixture (docs/07 §2 Genome/Brain mutation, tasks E03/E04). Pins the exact result of mutating the founder genome through a 50-generation lineage with a fixed PRNG seed, plus the PRNG draw count of a single birth. Any change to the draw order, the roll-interval partition, the sigma scaling or the clamp moves these values and is an ENGINE_VERSION event. Engine 0.5.0, 0.6.0, 0.7.0 and 0.8.0 all touched none of those: Milestone 8's species analysis draws nothing from the PRNG, and Milestone 9's command appliers are deliberately PRNG-free and never mutate a genome, and 0.8.0's expected-gain feeding rule and plant-capacity retune (ADR 0025) never touch a genome either — so the gene block, the brain digest and the PRNG state below are byte-identical to 0.4.0, and only the version stamps moved. Engine 0.9.0 (M14) regenerated every value: the morphological genome joined the inherited state and is mutated between the ecological block and the brain, so the PRNG stream, the resulting genes and the brain digest all move. A single birth now draws 599 words (was 572); the fixture gained a morphGenes array. Engine 0.11.0 (M16, ADR 0030) regenerated every value again: the neural topology genome joined the inherited state and is mutated between the morphological block and the weights, and the weight block itself grew 400 -> 576 for the recurrent and memory connections. A single birth now draws 788 words (was 599); the fixture gained a topology array. Weight mutation deliberately covers all 576: a weight mutation never reaches can never evolve, and the memory gate and value weights would have stayed permanently zero, making every register unwritable and the whole mechanism decoration. Engine 0.12.0 (M17, ADR 0031) regenerated every value again: the ecological genome went from 16 loci to 22 (the single signed `diet` locus out, six per-channel `Process` loci and `ToxinResistance` in), and the brain's input layer widened 20 -> 32 for the five per-channel densities and five gradient pairs, taking the weight block 400 -> 604 before M16's blocks and 576 -> 780 after them. A single birth now draws 1058 words (was 788): 204 of the increase is the wider weight block and the rest is the six added loci. The genes array is six entries longer.
